name: Loyalty Program
blurb: Active:  Renata sends out two chemtech rockets that strike targets around her, then converge into a single missile that explodes at the target location.

effects.description: Active: Renata sends out chemtech rockets from either side of her that instantly strike targets around her. After 0.429 seconds they converge and travel to the target location as a single missile, striking targets along its path and exploding upon reaching the target location.
Renata and allies struck are granted a shield for 3 seconds and enemies struck are dealt magic damage and slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.

notes:
Spell shield will block either the rockets while they are in-flight or their explosion.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
